articles.title: Transit advocates call the Orange Line extension proposal ‘not very serious.’ Two Boston councilors say it’s overdue.
articles.description:
While a proposed Orange Line extension could take 15 to 20 years to finish, the bus project is a more “near-term improvement,” a transit advocate said.

The post Transit advocates call the Orange Line extension proposal ‘not very serious.’ Two Boston councilors say it’s overdue. appeared first on Boston.com.
